eod.conclusion: Indian equity markets closed mixed with Nifty and Sensex declining slightly while Bank Nifty gained. Currency markets faced pressure from oil price movements, while corporate earnings and IPO activity indicated ongoing investor interest in select sectors. Global bond markets showed signs of stabilization after recent volatility, and cryptocurrency markets experienced significant gains, highlighting diverse investor sentiment across asset classes.
